messages.text: Process this consented architecture-review recording into minutes using our decision-record template, and flag every uncertain speaker attribution.
I recorded the recording authority, each participant's consent scope, the processed window, and the named decision owner and reviewer before transcribing anything.
Make it useful in a normal chat client and leave a durable handoff.

I produced the validated private meeting record and outputs/meeting-intelligence-handoff.md, with every uncertain attribution flagged, one withheld passage, a corrected rollback-window segment, and the DOCX draft left for the owner.

report.title: Meeting intelligence session handoff
report.summary: A private consent-bound meeting record with per-participant consent scopes, offset-linked transcript segments and confidence markers, decisions separated from proposals, acknowledged actions, corrections, conflicts, gaps, and a DOCX review draft awaiting the named owner.

items.title: Consent-bound meeting control
items.summary: The purpose, decision owner, reviewer, timezone, audience, retention rule, deletion owner, recording identity and digest, and each participant's consent scope are explicit

items.title: Transcript with visible uncertainty
items.summary: Every segment carries exact offsets, attribution state and confidence, uncertainty markers, correction lineage, and a withheld passage where consent was withdrawn

items.title: Decisions separated from discussion
items.summary: Decisions name an attending human, an explicit authority and agreement basis, and their supporting offsets; actions record acknowledgement, due dates, and dependencies

items.title: Owner-reviewed private handoff
items.summary: Open questions, parked topics, conflicts, corrections, gaps, and authority gates stay visible, and the DOCX record remains a review draft for the named owner.
